subject.title: Text between tool calls leaks to messaging channels

question: Should external source-chat delivery keep automatic bare-text replies as the default, or should messaging-channel/direct/source turns move toward message-tool-only or final-only semantics by default?
rationale: The safer behavior would reduce internal text leaks, but it can break existing users whose direct or channel workflows rely on automatic bare assistant replies, so automation should not choose the permanent default alone.

options.title: Safer default with migration
options.body: Move external messaging source replies toward message-tool/final-only delivery, with an opt-out or migration path for existing automatic bare-text deployments.

options.title: Keep automatic default plus guards
options.body: Preserve automatic bare-text replies as the default and land only targeted guards for commentary, NO_REPLY, cron reasoning, and known raw-tool leak shapes.

options.title: Opt-in only
options.body: Document and harden message-tool-only/final-tag modes as opt-in mitigations while leaving the central default unchanged for compatibility.

recommendation.title: Safer default with migration
recommendation.body: Move external messaging source replies toward message-tool/final-only delivery, with an opt-out or migration path for existing automatic bare-text deployments.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision crosses channel delivery defaults, security posture, and compatibility, and current blame plus prior review context point to steipete as the best available routing owner.
